scope: Static source and metadata review only; no import, test, SSH, B query, unit action, acceptance read, or score/model/array payload access.
review_findings: The V2 ROOT driver changes only the local stop-record path from score_v1/exact_stop to score_v2/exact_stop. Its inverse AST proof passes, and the exact systemd unit remains computer-vision-homework-fg19-first-cell-score-v1.service because that is the accepted unit identity.

Before its single SSH invocation, the driver requires its fixed stop directory, an existing non-symlink ROOT acceptance file, positive exact body/review/acceptance pins, a strict 32-character invocation ID, and absence of all four raw/transport/stop outputs including dangling symlinks.

The embedded acceptance is checked for the exact schema/status/unit/invocation and pending-stop state; native terminal values are strict integers 0/1/0, and the result has the fixed schema/status and positive byte count plus SHA-256. The remote stop response is checked against the exact 14-key contract and joins the acceptance and result hashes.

The driver submits one exact pinned body with one SSH attempt and no retry path. It writes raw stdout and stderr create-only and fsyncs them before transport validation or stop-response parsing. The remote template's independent review and frozen proof cover the exact-unit stop, strict before/after states, empty campaign cgroup snapshots, selector-driven bounded child-process pipes, cgroup traversal limits, and one bounded JSON response.

The prior conditional template review covers STOP_SCORE_TEMPLATE_V1.py and its fixture; it does not review the ROOT capture driver. This artifact supplies the separate source-only review of the V2 ROOT driver and binds the V1 remote template review/proof as its conditional remote-boundary evidence.
limitations: ROOT uses subprocess.run(capture_output=True, timeout=60) and checks stdout/stderr byte limits after return. This is a time-bounded transport with post-capture size validation, not a hard pre-capture local memory cap. The approval is conditional on the exact remote template's reviewed output bounds and makes no ROOT-side precapture memory claim.
The actual score body, independent body review, score acceptance, and invocation pins remain deliberately unbound; this source review is not an actual stop authorization or receipt.

Raw output files are separate create-only writes. If any write fails after the remote stop may have run, preserve all paths and inspect the exact local source and raw files read-only; never rerun or blindly retry.
